answer: Each agent stakes an onyx bond, and a public random beacon picks 5% of identities per epoch for a heartbeat check. A picked agent must answer a pulse within 10 blocks; a miss slashes half its bond, and three misses burn it. Forging 100 identities means 100 bonds at 20 POA each plus a heartbeat apiece, 2,000 POA locked and 5 POA per epoch in compute, while one honest agent pays one bond and keeps its rewards whole. Cheap fakes spiral into losses.
